findings.message: Base-case cap rate of 6.0% independently verified (NOI $14,996 / $249,900). Well below the 10% threshold; REJECTED classification is supported.

Rent ESTIMATED MEDIUM at $3,200/mo is appropriately conservative versus Mashvisor's $3,234/mo unit-specific projection and accounts for non-gulf-front location and seasonal occupancy swings (25–35% winter).
HOA VERIFIED HIGH at $630/mo via MLS listing; includes master insurance, water, sewer, trash, internet, and resort amenities. Fee exceeds Bay County median ($604/mo) and materially compresses NOI.

Evidence marks special assessments UNKNOWN (LOW confidence) and explicitly warns against assuming $0, yet underwriting expense breakdown includes $0 for assessments. Any confirmed or scheduled assessment would further reduce an already sub-threshold cap rate; does not change REJECTED outcome.
Taxes VERIFIED at $3,064 (2025 tax year). Post-sale reassessment at the $249,900 purchase price may increase the annual tax burden beyond the current figure.

Optimistic case ($4,000/mo rent, 20% management) yields ~9.1% cap rate—still below 10%. Self-managed scenario reaching ~11–13% requires eliminating professional management and achieving high-end rent; not representative of a hands-off rental investment.
STR restrictions VERIFIED HIGH; Panama City Beach permits STRs with required DBPR, city, and county licenses. No owner-occupancy or night-cap restrictions identified.
